import subprocess,re,os
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z']).decode().split('\\0')
p=r'(?i)(?:aws.{0,10}(?:key|secret)|api[_ -]?key|access[_ -]?token|secret[_ -]?key|github[_ -]?token|hugging[_ -]?face|hf[_ -]?token|password|bearer|credential)'
for f in files:
 if not f or f.startswith(('data/','tests/')) or f.endswith('Cargo.lock'):continue
 try:s=open(f).read()
 except (UnicodeError,OSError):continue
 for n,l in enumerate(s.splitlines(),1):
  if re.search(p,l) or re.search(r'gh[pousr]_',l):
   l=re.sub(r'\\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\\b|\\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]+\\b|\\bhf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\\b','[REDACTED]',l)
   l=re.sub(r'(?i)((?:secret|access_key|api_key|token|password)[\\w]*[\\s\\x22\\x27]*[:=][\\s]*[\\x22\\x27]?)([A-Za-z0-9/+_-]{20,})',r'\\1[REDACTED]',l)
   print(f'{f}:{n}: {l[:400]}')
print('History commits:',subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--all','--count']).decode().strip())
PY"
